description: This file contains a static utility class 'PropertyUtility' with methods for analyzing and matching properties and fields in C# code, likely used for code generation or reflection tasks within the Orleans project.

classes.name: PropertyUtility
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to match and analyze properties and fields, primarily for code reflection or generation purposes.

methods.name: GetMatchingProperty(IFieldSymbol field)
methods.description: Returns the property symbol that matches the given field symbol, based on naming conventions and type.

methods.name: IsCompilerGenerated(this ISymbol? symbol)
methods.description: Determines if a symbol has the 'CompilerGeneratedAttribute'.

methods.name: IsCompilerGenerated(this IPropertySymbol? property)
methods.description: Checks if a property is compiler-generated by examining its get and set methods.

methods.name: GetMatchingPrimaryConstructorParameter(IPropertySymbol property, IEnumerable<IParameterSymbol> constructorParameters)
methods.description: Finds the constructor parameter that matches a given property, assuming it was generated via constructor assignment.

methods.name: GetMatchingProperty(IFieldSymbol field, IEnumerable<ISymbol> memberSymbols)
methods.description: Finds a property that matches a given field, based on naming and type, using a regex to parse the field name.

methods.name: GetMatchingField(IPropertySymbol property)
methods.description: Returns the backing field symbol associated with the provided property.

methods.name: GetMatchingField(IPropertySymbol property, IEnumerable<ISymbol> memberSymbols)
methods.description: Finds the backing field for a given property from a list of members, based on naming conventions.

methods.name: GetCanonicalName(string name)
methods.description: Converts a property or field name to a canonical form by trimming underscores and adjusting capitalization.
